fact: The African Union Commission says its ad hoc committee inspected ClimSA and PUMA infrastructure deployed and installed in Nouakchott, Mauritania, the reception and processing chain for Meteosat Second and Third Generation data from EUMETSAT.
The African Union Commission's ClimSA deck lists Mauritania among 41 of 49 member states with a PUMA station installed as at 12 May 2026; the station carries satellite imagery.
